Here is the final recap for the Kovireel Christmas free-trial campaign (`wazzr`), which ran across all four days from **Monday, November 30, 2026 (00:00 EST)** through **Thursday, December 3, 2026 (24:00 EST)**.

### Overall Campaign Results
* **Total Spend:** **$940.86 USD** (`940,859,446` micros, out of the $950.00 budget cap — 99.0% utilization)
* **Impressions:** **499,407** (Unique Reach: **476,073**, Average Frequency: **1.05**)
* **Link Clicks:** **200** (Average CPC: **$4.70**, Total Engagements: **3,441**)

---

### Performance by Ad Group (Line Item)
All ad groups targeted **United States** users **aged 18+** (`LOCATION: US`, `AGE: AGE_OVER_18`) and optimized for **Link Clicks** (`WEBSITE_CLICKS` / `LINK_CLICKS`).

| Line Item | Targeting Strategy | Status at End | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg. CPC |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **LI2 (`c9zmv`)** | Anime, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Animation & Streaming Interests (US 18+) | Completed | $393.98 | 168,264 | 87 | $4.53 |
| **LI1 (`kk6v6`)** | Classic, Retro, Space & Mecha Anime Keywords (US 18+) | Completed | $251.67 | 173,587 | 54 | $4.66 |
| **LI4 (`k8ikk`)** | `@KovireelAnimeVa` Follower Lookalikes + Anime/Action/Sci-Fi (US 18+) | Completed | $130.86 | 75,360 | 30 | $4.36 |
| **LI5 (`t1d9v`)** | Top 2 Trial Posts — Anime, Space, Sci-Fi & Streaming (US 18+) | Completed | $113.11 | 67,412 | 28 | $4.04 |
| **LI3 (`5wfu9`)** | Desktop-Only Web Browser + Anime & Keywords (US 18+) | Paused Day 1 | $51.24 | 14,784 | 1 | $51.24 |
| **Total** | | | **$940.86** | **499,407** | **200** | **$4.70** |

---

### Performance by Approved Post
To maximize free-trial starts (rather than generic visits or gift invitation shares), we focused delivery on the three approved free-trial posts and excluded the generic site-visit post (`2125816818695947215`) and the invitation-share post (`2125635624760588388`):

| Post ID | Copy Summary | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg. CPC |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **`2125454430828252428`** | *"Two classics. One good night in. Explore curated double features... 14-day free trial."* | $426.07 | 207,818 | 97 | $4.39 |
| **`2125998012628324638`** | *"December 24 is the last day for our Christmas trial offer. Start your 14 free days..."* | $420.77 | 183,760 | 83 | $5.07 |
| **`2126179206560378851`** | *"14 days free, then $6.99/month. Make room for ’80s and ’90s anime double features..."* | $94.02 | 107,829 | 20 | $4.70 |
| **`2125635624760588388`** | Gift invitation share post *(not promoted — invitation shares not counted)* | $0.00 | 0 | 0 | — |
| **`2125816818695947215`** | Generic site visit post *(not promoted — visits without trial intent not counted)* | $0.00 | 0 | 0 | — |

### Key Adjustments Made During the Flight
1. **Paused Desktop-Only Restriction (`LI3`):** On Day 1, restricting delivery strictly to desktop (`PLATFORM: 4`) yielded only 1 link click for $51.24. We paused `LI3` and reallocated budget to cross-device US 18+ line items.
2. **Expanded Keywords & Launched Lookalike/Sci-Fi Segments (`LI4` & `LI5`):** We expanded retro/mecha keywords on `LI1`, launched `@KovireelAnimeVa` follower lookalikes (`LI4`), and created a dedicated ad group (`LI5`) for the top two trial-start posts (`2125454430828252428` and `2125998012628324638`), which achieved the lowest cost per link click (**$4.04 CPC**).
